sources.summary: Structured domestic B2B e-invoicing applies from 1 January 2026 for in-scope Belgian enterprises; an emailed PDF alone is insufficient. B2C-only sellers may still need supplier inbound receipt; software suppliers can use certified providers.

Specifies sending/receiving and transaction exceptions, including non-established taxpayers without a fixed establishment and article-44 cases. Its summary allows an agreed EN16931-compliant alternative to default Peppol BIS.
sources.limitations: Guidance is not a legal opinion. Underlying current law, exact company applicability and statutory policy require qualified review; no blanket VAT-number or Peppol-only rule is approved.

deliberateExclusions: First release is single legal company and EUR; full consolidation, SaaS tenancy and multi-company need later explicit requirements.
Full Belgian payroll calculation/certification, qualified-signature claims, IoT/VoIP hardware and industry-specific packages are not approved implementation scope.
Arbitrary spreadsheet/code execution and unrestricted low-code customization are excluded; only later bounded validated customization is proposed.
No copying Odoo source, proprietary assets, branding, live customer data or substantial documentation text.
No automatic Odoo cutover, production transmissions, transfers, filings, campaigns, deployment, provider signup or commercial spend.
Odoo marketing, guide examples and shared browser appearance do not certify legal compliance, edition parity or ODEE correctness.
